home.whyUsIntro: The educational programs of {{name}} are implemented within the framework of the Bologna Process parameters, meet modern requirements, are based on the educational systems of leading universities worldwide, and correspond to labor market demands.
home.aboutText: Training of specialists who are competitive in the modern labor market, distinguished by their intelligence, high culture and tolerance.

historyText: Founded in {{founded}}, {{name}} positions itself as one of the region's major multidisciplinary universities, training specialists in higher and postgraduate education across {{bachelor}} bachelor's programs and 9 master's programs.

The university is built on a classical educational model that integrates teaching, character-building, and research processes. This approach has allowed the university to maintain its standing in academic circles through a qualified faculty and the introduction of innovative programs.
Over {{years}} years of activity in higher and postgraduate education, the university has built a strong teaching-and-laboratory and material-technical base along with well-developed infrastructure.
52% of the university's faculty hold academic degrees and titles, including representatives of employers and practitioners from production enterprises.
The university operates two research institutes — Ecology and Biology, and Pedagogy and Psychology — which also cover biotechnology, chemical technology, and petrochemistry.
The university cooperates with 43 foreign universities under memoranda of understanding, supporting student academic mobility and joint research initiatives.
Over the course of its work, the university has graduated more than 50,000 specialists who now work successfully in Kazakhstan and internationally.
about.missionText: Training specialists who are competitive in today's labor market and distinguished by intellect, high culture, and tolerance.
visionText: {{name}} is a higher education institution that effectively carries out educational, research, and character-building activity on the principles of openness and academic integrity. The university sees itself as an innovation hub for educational and research services, aimed at transferring knowledge and technology, supporting student initiatives, and commercializing research results.
The university's educational activity is aimed at creating, accumulating, and disseminating modern knowledge, drawing on the potential of its research laboratories and teaching-and-research centers.

{{name}} strives for a leading position in training specialists for various sectors of the economy, combining the quality of education with the introduction of innovative technologies and support for the cultural and moral values of society.

dormText: {{name}} students have access to accommodation in the student residence (dormitory), which has 210 places. The residence offers comfortable conditions: dining halls and shower rooms are available, along with a laundry, a study room, and free Wi-Fi.
In addition to the main student residence, further places are available on a contractual basis: 200 places in the Sayram district residence and 150 places in the «Turan» residence.
Places in the residence are allocated on a competitive basis by a specially formed commission, whose work is overseen by the vice-rector for social and educational affairs.
inclusiveText: {{name}} adapts its learning and teaching conditions to the needs of students with special educational needs (SEN) — students with limited abilities related to health status, as well as socioeconomic background, gender, language of instruction (including international students), and other factors.

The university's goal is to create a comfortable environment for students with SEN and support them in overcoming difficulties, developing their abilities, and achieving success in their studies and lives.
inclusiveItems: A barrier-free environment: ramps, elevators, accessible entrances, tactile guides
Individual and adapted study plans, with consultations arranged as needed
Special software and assistive technology for learning
An accessible site version for the visually impaired and sign-language interpretation
Special classes to increase physical activity
Open access to the inclusive education strategy and regulations, methodological recommendations, and the equality, diversity, and inclusion policy
